question: Where’s the closest hotel located east of Luthy Botanical Garden, Peoria, IL?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE tourism = 'hotel' AND ST_X(geometry) > ST_X(( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Luthy Botanical Garden%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Peoria%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%IL%' LIMIT 1 )) ORDER BY geometry <-> ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Luthy Botanical Garden%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Peoria%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%IL%' LIMIT 1 ) LIMIT 1;
